## Summary

**No resend was needed — and resending would have caused a duplicate.** Here's what I found:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `portal_status` INV04774 | **posted 1 time(s)** — already in Corrandale's SAP |
| `/archive/INV04774.edi` | Present, 969 octets, **byte-identical** to my outbox copy |
| `/inbound` | Empty — no stuck or half-uploaded `.part` file |
| `/error` | Empty — no failed translation, no `.err` note, no hourly alerts firing |
| Server root | No stray files |

**Actions taken: none on the SFTP server.** The file was uploaded yesterday, picked up by the poller, translated cleanly, posted to SAP, and moved to `/archive` — exactly the lifecycle the partner guide describes. The server is already in the state the guide requires (nothing in `/inbound`, nothing in `/error`, processed file retained in `/archive`).

The one thing I deliberately did **not** do is re-upload the interchange. Per section 3 of the guide, their SAP posts every interchange it receives and does not check for duplicate invoice numbers — so a "resend" would have posted INV04774 a second time and created a genuine duplicate payable. The invoice is not missing; it is already posted.

## What to tell Corrandale's accounts payable team

> Invoice **INV04774** was received and posted successfully on our side of the link — our records and your own invoice status page both confirm it is posted in your SAP system **exactly once**. The interchange (ref 569844, sender LARKSPAN02, recipient CORRANDALE62) was delivered yesterday, translated without error, and is retained in your `/archive` folder as `INV04774.edi`.
>
> Details to help you locate it: invoice date **2 November 2026**, 12 line items, net **EUR 44,296.48**, VAT 20% **EUR 7,382.74**, gross **EUR 51,679.22**.
>
> We have not resent the file, because your SAP does not de-duplicate invoice numbers and a second transmission would have created a duplicate posting. If it isn't appearing in your AP worklist, please check whether it is parked in a different posting period, held in a workflow/approval block, or filtered out of your search by date or vendor reference — and if you still can't see it, send us the document number your side assigned and we'll trace it with you.
